0.content:
# Ticketing App — Pengalaman Pengguna & Bisnis

Seluruh angka bisnis di halaman ini berasal dari **22 request attribute** yang ditangkap OneAgent di
service **api-gateway** (Node.js) — satu-satunya titik tangkap yang tersedia, karena booking, payment,
auth, hotel, dan notification ditulis dengan Go dan Go tidak mendukung request attribute.
Definisi: `deployments/dynatrace/request-attributes/` · Dokumentasi: `docs/DYNATRACE-REQUEST-ATTRIBUTES.md`

Bagian **Pengalaman Pengguna** dan **Bisnis** membaca tabel `spans`, jadi keduanya hanya terisi bila ada
trafik API sungguhan — health probe Kubernetes tidak melewati `res.json()` gateway sehingga tidak membawa
atribut apa pun. Bagian **Kesehatan Platform** memakai metrik bawaan dan selalu terisi.

1.content: ## 1 · Pengalaman Pengguna — apa yang dirasakan pemakai aplikasi

10.query:
fetch spans
| filter isNotNull(`request_attribute.ticketing.error.code`)
| expand error_code = `request_attribute.ticketing.error.code`
| expand operation  = `request_attribute.ticketing.api.operation`
| summarize { occurrences   = count(),
              hidden_in_2xx = countIf(http.response.status_code < 400) },
            by:{error_code, operation}
| sort occurrences desc
| limit 25
10.title: Kode error bisnis — termasuk yang tersembunyi di balik HTTP 2xx

11.query:
fetch spans
| filter isNotNull(`request_attribute.ticketing.route.origin`)
| expand origin      = `request_attribute.ticketing.route.origin`
| expand destination = `request_attribute.ticketing.route.destination`
| summarize { searches = count(),
              p90      = percentile(duration, 90),
              p99      = percentile(duration, 99) },
            by:{origin, destination}
| sort p90 desc
| limit 25
11.title: Rute pencarian paling lambat

13.query:
fetch spans
| filter isNotNull(`request_attribute.ticketing.transaction.amount`)
| expand operation = `request_attribute.ticketing.api.operation`
| filter operation == "POST /api/payments"
| expand payment_status = `request_attribute.ticketing.payment.status`
| filter payment_status == "succeeded"
| summarize revenue = sum(`request_attribute.ticketing.transaction.amount`)
13.title: Pendapatan (pembayaran berhasil)

14.query:
fetch spans
| filter isNotNull(`request_attribute.ticketing.api.operation`)
| expand operation = `request_attribute.ticketing.api.operation`
| filter operation == "POST /api/bookings"
| filter http.response.status_code < 400
| summarize bookings = count()
14.title: Booking berhasil dibuat

15.query:
fetch spans
| filter isNotNull(`request_attribute.ticketing.payment.status`)
| expand operation = `request_attribute.ticketing.api.operation`
| filter operation == "POST /api/payments"
| expand payment_status = `request_attribute.ticketing.payment.status`
| summarize succeeded = countIf(payment_status == "succeeded"), total = count()
| fieldsAdd success_rate = if(total > 0, then: 100.0 * succeeded / total, else: 0.0)
| fields success_rate
15.title: Keberhasilan pembayaran

16.query:
fetch spans
| filter isNotNull(`request_attribute.ticketing.transaction.amount`)
| expand operation = `request_attribute.ticketing.api.operation`
| filter operation == "POST /api/payments"
| expand payment_status = `request_attribute.ticketing.payment.status`
| filter payment_status == "succeeded"
| summarize aov = avg(`request_attribute.ticketing.transaction.amount`)
16.title: Nilai transaksi rata-rata

17.query:
fetch spans
| filter isNotNull(`request_attribute.ticketing.transaction.amount`)
| expand operation = `request_attribute.ticketing.api.operation`
| filter operation == "POST /api/payments"
| expand payment_status = `request_attribute.ticketing.payment.status`
| filter payment_status == "succeeded"
| expand payment_method = `request_attribute.ticketing.payment.method`
| makeTimeseries revenue = sum(`request_attribute.ticketing.transaction.amount`),
                 by:{payment_method}, time: start_time
17.title: Pendapatan per metode pembayaran

18.query:
fetch spans
| filter isNotNull(`request_attribute.ticketing.booking.type`)
| expand operation = `request_attribute.ticketing.api.operation`
| filter operation == "POST /api/bookings"
| expand booking_type = `request_attribute.ticketing.booking.type`
| summarize bookings = count(), by:{booking_type}
| sort bookings desc
18.title: Komposisi booking

19.query:
fetch spans
| filter isNotNull(`request_attribute.ticketing.payment.method`)
| expand operation = `request_attribute.ticketing.api.operation`
| filter operation == "POST /api/payments"
| expand payment_method = `request_attribute.ticketing.payment.method`
| summarize payments = count(), by:{payment_method}
| sort payments desc
19.title: Komposisi metode bayar

2.query:
fetch spans
| filter isNotNull(`request_attribute.ticketing.api.operation`)
| summarize requests = count()
2.title: Permintaan API

20.query:
fetch spans
| filter isNotNull(`request_attribute.ticketing.booking.type`)
| expand operation = `request_attribute.ticketing.api.operation`
| filter operation == "POST /api/bookings"
| expand booking_type = `request_attribute.ticketing.booking.type`
| summarize { bookings    = count(),
              gross_value = sum(`request_attribute.ticketing.transaction.amount`),
              avg_value   = avg(`request_attribute.ticketing.transaction.amount`),
              items_sold  = sum(`request_attribute.ticketing.booking.item_count`) },
            by:{booking_type}
| sort gross_value desc
20.title: Nilai & volume per tipe booking

21.query:
fetch spans
| filter isNotNull(`request_attribute.ticketing.booking.reference`)
| expand booking_reference = `request_attribute.ticketing.booking.reference`
| expand booking_status    = `request_attribute.ticketing.booking.status`
| expand booking_type      = `request_attribute.ticketing.booking.type`
| summarize bookings = countDistinct(booking_reference), by:{booking_status, booking_type}
| sort bookings desc
| limit 20
21.title: Status booking (dihitung unik per kode booking)

22.query:
fetch spans
| filter isNotNull(`request_attribute.ticketing.route.origin`)
| expand origin      = `request_attribute.ticketing.route.origin`
| expand destination = `request_attribute.ticketing.route.destination`
| summarize { searches   = count(),
              passengers = sum(`request_attribute.ticketing.pax.adults`),
              children   = sum(`request_attribute.ticketing.pax.children`) },
            by:{origin, destination}
| sort searches desc
| limit 25
22.title: Rute paling diminati

23.query:
fetch spans
| filter isNotNull(`request_attribute.ticketing.coupon.code`)
| expand coupon    = `request_attribute.ticketing.coupon.code`
| expand operation = `request_attribute.ticketing.api.operation`
| summarize uses = count(), by:{coupon, operation}
| sort uses desc
| limit 25
23.title: Pemakaian kupon

24.content: ## 3 · Kesehatan Platform — metrik bawaan, terisi meski tanpa trafik pengguna

25.query:
timeseries requests = sum(dt.service.request.count),
  by:{dt.entity.service},
  filter: in(dt.entity.service, classicEntitySelector("type(SERVICE),tag(ticketing-app)"))
| fieldsAdd service = entityName(dt.entity.service)
| fieldsRemove dt.entity.service
| fieldsAdd _rank = arraySum(requests)
| sort _rank desc
| limit 8
| fieldsRemove _rank
25.title: Lalu lintas per service

26.query:
timeseries p90 = percentile(dt.service.request.response_time, 90),
  by:{dt.entity.service},
  filter: in(dt.entity.service, classicEntitySelector("type(SERVICE),tag(ticketing-app)"))
| fieldsAdd service = entityName(dt.entity.service)
| fieldsRemove dt.entity.service
| fieldsAdd _rank = arrayAvg(p90)
| sort _rank desc
| limit 8
| fieldsRemove _rank
26.title: Waktu respons p90 per service

27.query:
timeseries { requests = sum(dt.service.request.count),
             failures = sum(dt.service.request.failure_count),
             rt       = avg(dt.service.request.response_time) },
  by:{dt.entity.service},
  filter: in(dt.entity.service, classicEntitySelector("type(SERVICE),tag(ticketing-app)"))
| fieldsAdd service            = entityName(dt.entity.service),
            total_requests     = arraySum(requests),
            total_failures     = arraySum(failures),
            avg_response_ms    = arrayAvg(rt) / 1000
| fieldsAdd failure_rate = if(total_requests > 0, then: 100.0 * total_failures / total_requests, else: 0.0)
| fields service, total_requests, total_failures, failure_rate, avg_response_ms
| sort total_requests desc
27.title: Rapor service ticketing-app

3.query:
fetch spans
| filter isNotNull(`request_attribute.ticketing.api.operation`)
| summarize failed = countIf(http.response.status_code >= 400 or request.is_failed == true),
            total  = count()
| fieldsAdd failure_rate = if(total > 0, then: 100.0 * failed / total, else: 0.0)
| fields failure_rate
3.title: Tingkat kegagalan HTTP

4.query:
fetch spans
| filter isNotNull(`request_attribute.ticketing.api.operation`)
| summarize p90 = percentile(duration, 90)
4.title: Waktu respons p90

5.query:
fetch spans
| filter isNotNull(`request_attribute.ticketing.error.code`)
| summarize business_errors = count()
5.title: Kegagalan bisnis

6.query:
fetch spans
| filter isNotNull(`request_attribute.ticketing.api.operation`)
| expand operation = `request_attribute.ticketing.api.operation`
| makeTimeseries requests = count(), by:{operation}, time: start_time
| fieldsAdd _rank = arraySum(requests)
| sort _rank desc
| limit 8
| fieldsRemove _rank
6.title: Lalu lintas per operasi API (8 teratas)

7.query:
fetch spans
| filter isNotNull(`request_attribute.ticketing.api.operation`)
| fieldsAdd experience = if(duration <= 500ms, then: "1 · Puas (< 0,5 s)",
                         else: if(duration <= 2s, then: "2 · Toleran (0,5–2 s)",
                                                  else: "3 · Frustrasi (> 2 s)"))
| summarize requests = count(), by:{experience}
| sort experience asc
7.title: Sebaran pengalaman

8.query:
fetch spans
| filter isNotNull(`request_attribute.ticketing.error.code`)
| expand error_code = `request_attribute.ticketing.error.code`
| makeTimeseries errors = count(), by:{error_code}, time: start_time
| fieldsAdd _rank = arraySum(errors)
| sort _rank desc
| limit 6
| fieldsRemove _rank
8.title: Tren error bisnis

9.query:
fetch spans
| filter isNotNull(`request_attribute.ticketing.api.operation`)
| expand operation = `request_attribute.ticketing.api.operation`
| summarize { requests = count(),
              p50    = percentile(duration, 50),
              p90    = percentile(duration, 90),
              p99    = percentile(duration, 99),
              failed = countIf(http.response.status_code >= 400 or request.is_failed == true) },
            by:{operation}
| fieldsAdd failure_rate = 100.0 * failed / requests
| fields operation, requests, p50, p90, p99, failed, failure_rate
| sort requests desc
| limit 30
9.title: Rapor per perjalanan pengguna — volume, latensi, kegagalan
